late_event_policy: drop events older than the event-time watermark; ordered replay has no late events
duplicate_policy: in-memory monotonic source cursor; consumed offsets are idempotent within the active replay; durable checkpoint recovery is out of scope
candidate_protocol: frozen stage-one test positives plus 100 fixed negatives; evaluate before each user's first test timestamp
ranking: cumulative item positive count plus weighted 30-day item positive count and weighted mean user genre affinity; score descending, movieId ascending
